page.overview:
Who is Giants of Albion?

The Giants of Albion is both a reference to the Giants who inhabit the island of Albion and a mercenary band consisting of two Giants native to that island named Bologs and Cachtorr, who are always accompanied into battle by Hengus the Druid.

Forged from the earth itself, the Giants of Albion are its guardians. They are powerful creatures given to rage easily and often rampage throughout the land to deter would-be adventurers. Most of the larger Giants of Albion slumber in caves and are seldom ever seen by the eyes of man. Some of the younger, more naive beasts are given to sleeping in the open; however, prey to monster hunters and thieves, which is, of course, if the young Giant does not wake.

The druids of the island of Albion say that the race of mighty Giants that inhabit their island were put there by the Old Ones to guard the island from invaders. Whether this is true, none can say.

Yet the Giants prowl the rugged coasts to this day. They wander along the fog-shrouded cliffs and hurl boulders down onto hapless ships which come too close to the shore, taking a childlike joy in watching them splinter into matchsticks and the doomed crew struggling in the fierce waves.
